skill.name: brainstorming-features
skill.description: Facilitates creative ideation sessions for mobile and web app features, generating structured ideas with user stories, technical considerations, and implementation suggestions. Use when planning new features, exploring product direction, generating app ideas, feature discovery, product brainstorming, or when user mentions 'brainstorm', 'ideate', 'app ideas', or 'feature suggestions'.
skill.summary: Generate structured web and mobile app feature ideas with user stories, technical notes, and prioritization.
skill.author: Emz1998

content.user_title: Brainstorm App Features with Structured Ideas
content.value_statement: Teams need practical feature ideas that connect user value, feasibility, and metrics. This skill guides structured brainstorming for web and mobile app planning.
actual_capabilities: Generates structured feature briefs with problem, users, user story, capabilities, technical notes, impact, and metrics.
Supports problem-first, opportunity-first, competitive, and user journey ideation methods.
Ranks ideas by value, effort, complexity, and implementation impact.
Produces concise feature lists, detailed briefs, and phased roadmap outlines.
Includes example outputs for note-taking, ecommerce, and fitness app scenarios.
limitations: It does not validate market demand with real users.
It does not execute research, analytics, or competitor data collection.
Technical estimates are directional and need engineering review.
Generated metrics are examples unless project data is provided.

use_cases.title: Prioritize an MVP Backlog
use_cases.description: Turn a broad product direction into ranked feature ideas with user stories and success metrics.

use_cases.title: Explore New App Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate practical feature options for a new web or mobile product before design work begins.

use_cases.title: Scope Technical Effort
use_cases.description: Review proposed ideas with implementation complexity, dependencies, and likely engineering constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Starter Ideas
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for broad feature discovery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Brainstorm 5 feature ideas for a [platform] app that helps [target users] solve [main problem]. Include user value and complexity.

prompt_templates.title: Create Feature Briefs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for structured product planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these user pain points into 3 detailed feature briefs: [pain points]. For each brief, include user story, capabilities, technical considerations, and metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Roadmap Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for ranking and planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these feature ideas for [product]: [ideas]. Rank them by value, effort, dependencies, and MVP fit, then suggest a phased roadmap.

prompt_templates.title: Run Competitive Discovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for differentiated product strategy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare our current product, [product summary], against these competitor strengths: [competitor notes]. Brainstorm differentiated features with feasibility tradeoffs and success metrics.

output_examples.input: Brainstorm study features for a mobile note-taking app for nursing students.
output: AI flashcard generation from class notes, with edit controls and spaced repetition.
Clinical term glossary linked to saved notes and exam topics.
Study session planner that recommends review blocks before exams.

output_examples.input: Brainstorm checkout flow improvements for an early stage ecommerce site.
output: Guest checkout express to reduce account creation friction.
Smart address autocomplete to reduce delivery errors.
Cart recovery messages with optional incentives and timing controls.

output_examples.input: Generate gamification ideas for a fitness tracking app.
output: Achievement streak tracker with milestone rewards and streak protection.
Personal challenge cards based on recent activity patterns.
Progress sharing flow for completed goals and badges.

best_practices: Provide audience, platform, current features, and constraints before asking for ideas.
Ask for both user value and technical feasibility for each proposed feature.
Review top ideas with users and engineers before adding them to a roadmap.
anti_patterns: Ask for feature ideas without explaining the product or user problem.
Treat generated impact metrics as validated business forecasts.
Move ideas directly into development without scope, design, or technical review.

faq.question: What products does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports mobile apps, web apps, desktop apps, and progressive web apps.

faq.question: Does it build the feature?
faq.answer: No. It produces product planning guidance, feature briefs, and roadmap suggestions.

faq.question: Can it help with MVP planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can rank features by value, effort, complexity, dependencies, and MVP fit.

faq.question: Does it perform market research?
faq.answer: No. It can structure competitor notes, but it does not gather external research by itself.

faq.question: How much context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target user, main problem, platform, current features, constraints, and goals.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
